answer: Each agent may request a scarce compute-backed credential, but the issuer grants it only after the requester completes a random delay puzzle whose solution is cheap to verify and tied to that credential’s public key. A sybil attacker must pay the puzzle’s compute and energy cost for every identity, while honest agents reuse one credential; splitting identities no longer multiplies influence for free. The nectar market can flourish without letting one operator flood the atlas, even near the nadir of trust.
